newsitem.title: UK: Stg/mark sets new highs, cable claws back ground.
newsitem.headline: Stg/mark sets new highs, cable claws back ground.

text.p: 1310 GMT - Stg/mark tops 3.03 to reach highest levels since Oct 1990. Broad-based mark weakness initiated stg gains Monday but cable also rebounding now.
* Stg at 3.0320/25 marks, $1.6908/18 vs 2.9985/95, $1.6860/70 late Friday in Europe. Stg trade-weighted index at 105.5, highest since August 1990.
* Stg unfazed by larger-than-expected declines in UK PPI as rate-rise expectations remain intact. Output prices fell 0.2 percent in June, input prices dropped 0.8 percent.
* Sept short stg down three bps at 92.83, implying rates of 7.17 pct at end Q3 vs current base rates of 6.75 pct.
* IoD says manufacturing conditions remained buoyant in latest quarter as strong domestic demand offset stg strength.
